title: 【稲佐山展望台】11月24日(火) 工事に伴う閉鎖のお知らせ – 【公式】稲佐山公園

facts.fact: On24November2026from09:00to18:00, electrical works close summit-building facilities including restaurant,cafe,lift and toilets; the rooftop remains accessible by outside spiral stairs. This is not a complete closure of the mountain or roof.
facts.excerpt: 令和8年11月24日(火曜日) 9時～18時

facts.fact: The roof remains accessible by the external spiral staircase during that temporary building closure; the lift and toilets are unavailable.
